title: Pay to leave the game
hook: Two stated cases: explore the monetary cost of exit.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the monetary cost of exit affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Kept, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the monetary cost of exit in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
